ResearchTabDef.label: Archotech
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: You have to know how to take the first step...

ResearchProjectDef.label: understanding the machine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Step inside and discover a new age of technology
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Once you stepped inside the machine, it whirred to life. The chamber felt chillingly cold as if the machine exposed you to the vacuum of space itself. As you stand inside, your head feels heavy, your brain feels taxed. Its then that you understand the machine, and its function.

As bits of information float into your mind, you realize what the data Starway was trying to keep secret revealed. It was research into the supernatural beings known as Archotechs. Starway had tried and failed to understand how the technology behind their creations worked.

You sense that more time within the machine will possibly unveil some of these grand mysteries to you. In the same way you would throw a dart at a target, you could possibly try to recreate some of the ancient technology. In time.

This first foray into the unknown leaves you with thoughts behind the design of the machine itself. You can now build a replacement if you lose the original.
